ref_text: MY HEART DOTH PLEAD THAT THOU IN HIM DOST LIE A CLOSET NEVER PIERC'D WITH CRYSTAL EYES BUT THE DEFENDANT DOTH THAT PLEA DENY AND SAYS IN HIM THY FAIR APPEARANCE LIES
text: My heart-doth plead that thou in him dost lie, a closet never pierced with crystal eyes. But the defendant, doth, that plea, deny, and says in him thy fair appearance lies.
